ai_summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has received Establishment Inspection Reports (EIRs) from the USFDA, formally closing the unannounced inspection at its Vadodara Bioequivalence Facility. This positive outcome, following a previously reported successful inspection, confirms the facility's compliance with USFDA standards, ensuring continued market access and mitigating significant regulatory risks. There are no red flags; this development is a favorable update for the company's operational continuity and regulatory standing.
